questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a detailed examination of a subject'?
explanation: Analysis is correct - A-N-A-L-Y-S-I-S. An analysis is a detailed examination of the elements of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a talk given to a group of students'?
explanation: Lecture is correct - L-E-C-T-U-R-E. A lecture is an educational talk delivered to an audience.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the main idea of a piece of writing'?
explanation: Thesis is correct - T-H-E-S-I-S. A thesis is the central argument of an academic paper.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a document showing study topics'?
explanation: Syllabus is correct - S-Y-L-L-A-B-U-S. A syllabus outlines the topics covered in a course. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the act of taking in and learning'?
explanation: Comprehension is correct - C-O-M-P-R-E-H-E-N-S-I-O-N. Comprehension is the ability to understand what is read or heard.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal examination'?
explanation: Assessment is correct - A-S-S-E-S-S-M-E-N-T. An assessment is an evaluation of knowledge or skills. Double S appears twice.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a note explaining a text'?
explanation: Annotation is correct - A-N-N-O-T-A-T-I-O-N. An annotation is a note added to a text to explain or comment. Double N.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal discussion on a topic'?
explanation: Seminar is correct - S-E-M-I-N-A-R. A seminar is a small group meeting for discussion or instruction.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability to read and write'?
explanation: Literacy is correct - L-I-T-E-R-A-C-Y. Literacy is the ability to read and write.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a method of solving a problem'?
explanation: Methodology is correct - M-E-T-H-O-D-O-L-O-G-Y. Methodology is the system of methods used in a field of study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability to work with numbers'?
explanation: Numeracy is correct - N-U-M-E-R-A-C-Y. Numeracy is the ability to understand and work with numbers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'referring to sources used in writing'?
explanation: Bibliography is correct - B-I-B-L-I-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. A bibliography is a list of sources used in a piece of writing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to conclude from evidence'?
explanation: Inference is correct - I-N-F-E-R-E-N-C-E. An inference is a conclusion reached through reasoning.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the way a story is structured'?
explanation: Narrative is correct - N-A-R-R-A-T-I-V-E. A narrative is the way a story is told or structured. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a piece of academic writing'?
explanation: Dissertation is correct - D-I-S-S-E-R-T-A-T-I-O-N. A dissertation is a long piece of academic writing. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to examine evidence carefully'?
explanation: Evaluate is correct - E-V-A-L-U-A-T-E. To evaluate means to assess or judge the quality of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a summary of main points'?
explanation: Synopsis is correct - S-Y-N-O-P-S-I-S. A synopsis is a brief summary of a longer work.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a type of learning by doing'?
explanation: Experiential is correct - E-X-P-E-R-I-E-N-T-I-A-L. Experiential learning involves direct practical experience.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a comparison of two things'?
explanation: Analogy is correct - A-N-A-L-O-G-Y. An analogy is a comparison of two different things to explain one of them.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a belief or position taken in an argument'?
explanation: Hypothesis is correct - H-Y-P-O-T-H-E-S-I-S. A hypothesis is a proposed explanation tested through research.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the presentation of information in a visual format'?
explanation: Infographic is correct - I-N-F-O-G-R-A-P-H-I-C. An infographic presents data or information in a visual format.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability to think about your own thinking'?
explanation: Metacognition is correct - M-E-T-A-C-O-G-N-I-T-I-O-N. Metacognition is awareness and understanding of your own thought processes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'learning achieved outside school'?
explanation: Autodidactic is correct - A-U-T-O-D-I-D-A-C-T-I-C. Autodidactic means self-taught or self-educated.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'giving credit to a source'?
explanation: Citation is correct - C-I-T-A-T-I-O-N. A citation is a reference to a source of information in academic writing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to summarize key points'?
explanation: Paraphrase is correct - P-A-R-A-P-H-R-A-S-E. To paraphrase means to restate something in different words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'ability to think critically'?
explanation: Analytical is correct - A-N-A-L-Y-T-I-C-A-L. Analytical means relating to the examination of something in detail.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a study of how knowledge is justified'?
explanation: Epistemology is correct - E-P-I-S-T-E-M-O-L-O-G-Y. Epistemology is the branch of philosophy that studies knowledge.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a broad general principle'?
explanation: Axiom is correct - A-X-I-O-M. An axiom is a self-evident truth that requires no proof.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'practical use of knowledge'?
explanation: Application is correct - A-P-P-L-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. Application is the practical use of knowledge or skills. Double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'learning that has a lasting impact'?
explanation: Transformative is correct - T-R-A-N-S-F-O-R-M-A-T-I-V-E. Transformative education produces profound long-lasting change.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a structured course of study'?
explanation: Curriculum is correct - C-U-R-R-I-C-U-L-U-M. A curriculum is the set of courses offered by a school. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a way of teaching'?
explanation: Pedagogy is correct - P-E-D-A-G-O-G-Y. Pedagogy is the method and practice of teaching.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability to apply knowledge to new situations'?
explanation: Transferable is correct - T-R-A-N-S-F-E-R-A-B-L-E. Transferable skills can be applied in different contexts.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal written argument'?
explanation: Essay is correct - E-S-S-A-Y. An essay is a short piece of writing on a topic. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to copy someone else work dishonestly'?
explanation: Plagiarism is correct - P-L-A-G-I-A-R-I-S-M. Plagiarism is presenting someone else work as your own.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a person who guides students'?
explanation: Mentor is correct - M-E-N-T-O-R. A mentor is an experienced person who guides a less experienced person.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a set of test questions'?
explanation: Questionnaire is correct - Q-U-E-S-T-I-O-N-N-A-I-R-E. A questionnaire is a set of printed questions to gather information. Double N.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a teaching method using problem-solving'?
explanation: Heuristic is correct - H-E-U-R-I-S-T-I-C. A heuristic method encourages students to learn through discovery.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a student at a school'?
explanation: Pupil is correct - P-U-P-I-L. A pupil is a student, especially a child who is taught at school.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to practice or repeat to learn'?
explanation: Rehearsal is correct - R-E-H-E-A-R-S-A-L. A rehearsal is a practice session before a performance or presentation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'ideas based on practical experience'?
explanation: Empirical is correct - E-M-P-I-R-I-C-A-L. Empirical evidence is based on observation or experience.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a supervised practical class'?
explanation: Laboratory is correct - L-A-B-O-R-A-T-O-R-Y. A laboratory is a room equipped for scientific experiments.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the act of discussing two sides of an issue'?
explanation: Debate is correct - D-E-B-A-T-E. A debate is a formal discussion on a topic with opposing viewpoints.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a reward for doing well'?
explanation: Scholarship is correct - S-C-H-O-L-A-R-S-H-I-P. A scholarship is a financial grant awarded to a student for academic achievement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'to look carefully at a piece of text'?
explanation: Scrutinize is correct - S-C-R-U-T-I-N-I-Z-E. To scrutinize means to examine carefully and thoroughly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a test used to see what students know'?
explanation: Diagnostic is correct - D-I-A-G-N-O-S-T-I-C. A diagnostic test identifies what a student knows and needs to learn.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a formal collection of work'?
explanation: Portfolio is correct - P-O-R-T-F-O-L-I-O. A portfolio is a collection of a student work showing their progress.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a school subject'?
explanation: Discipline is correct - D-I-S-C-I-P-L-I-N-E. Discipline is a branch of knowledge or subject.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'giving feedback on work'?
explanation: Critique is correct - C-R-I-T-I-Q-U-E. A critique is a detailed analysis and assessment of a piece of work.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'drawing conclusions from general principles'?
explanation: Deductive is correct - D-E-D-U-C-T-I-V-E. Deductive reasoning draws specific conclusions from general rules.
